tutorial.say: This clue (a paint bucket) counts an AREA: all the cells connected to it, side by side, that are in the same state as its own cell. It sits on a bomb, so it counts connected bombs. It says 4.
Here they are: 4 bombs touching each other form one area. Cells that only touch by a corner do not belong to it.
It works for safe cells too. This clue sits on a safe cell and counts the connected safe cells: only 2, because bombs fence the pocket in.

tutorial.play: Your turn! The board is cleared again. Find all the bombs.
